title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 294 (Infinite Update Prompt Fix & Google Drive Cloud Backup)
highlights: Fixed Update Prompt Loop: Corrected app internal build number so update dialog stops popping up once updated.
100% Silent Google Drive Auto-Backup: Invoices and data changes are automatically backed up to Google Drive in the background with zero pop-up interruptions.
Auto-Sync on Bill and Exit: Instant silent backup triggers on invoice creation, app minimize, and app exit.
Automatic License & Company Logo Recovery: Pro activation and branding persist across all backup and restore cycles.
fixes: Synchronized AppMetadata.buildNumber to 294 to resolve repeated update prompts.
Integrated Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client credentials with Android Credential Manager.
Added debounced background auto-backup worker on billing and system back exit.
